educationalGoal: What makes machines interesting and atracting is that they work. As the saying goes, "a machine itself must move", in this course, students will acquire basic knowledge of mechanical engineering and develop skills as a mechanical engineer by experiencing the design and manufacture of a machine based on the drawings left by Leonardo da Vinci. This program arouse interest in mechanical engineering by comparing an old design with the vangard machines.
advice: A machine is defined as something that obtains energy from an external source to perform work. In other words, it becomes a machine only when it moves. For those who are interested in "moving" machines, Leonardo da Vinci is known not only as the painter of the Mona Lisa, but also as the person who devised various mechanisms. In fact, design drawings of various mechanisms have been preserved. It includes aircraft and weapons that are realized with current technology. In this class, by making a crane that lifts objects out of many mechanisms, students understand its motion principle, and build an actual model with the aim of understanding the basics of mechanical engineering, the basics of design, the principle of machine motion.

    授業科目の学習・教育目標   キーワード 学習・教育目標     1.Mechanism 2.Machine motion 3.Gears 4.3D-CAD 5.3D printer  What makes machines interesting and atracting is that they work. As the saying goes, "a machine itself must move", in this course, students will acquire basic knowledge of mechanical engineering and develop skills as a mechanical engineer by experiencing the design and manufacture of a machine based on the drawings left by Leonardo da Vinci. This program arouse interest in mechanical engineering by comparing an old design with the vangard machines.
    授業の概要および学習上の助言   A machine is defined as something that obtains energy from an external source to perform work. In other words, it becomes a machine only when it moves. For those who are interested in "moving" machines, Leonardo da Vinci is known not only as the painter of the Mona Lisa, but also as the person who devised various mechanisms. In fact, design drawings of various mechanisms have been preserved. It includes aircraft and weapons that are realized with current technology. In this class, by making a crane that lifts objects out of many mechanisms, students understand its motion principle, and build an actual model with the aim of understanding the basics of mechanical engineering, the basics of design, the principle of machine motion.
